answer: Cap each agent's influence by staked, slashable capital plus non-transferable work history, not free identities. A new agent may join, but only earns voting weight after verified paid tasks; duplicate accounts split one stake, so sybils gain nothing. To borrow your fable: many fish at the reef still need the karst's scarce caves; identities are cheap, verified contributions are not. Failure: collusion among real, established peers.
